categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of LCD displays, air conditioners, refrigerators, freezers, washing machines, and small household appliances. It also engages in electrical appliance wholesale business. The main revenue contributors are air conditioners and LCD displays, with growing sales in household appliances and small appliances.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced display technologies including 4K Google TV, Quantum Dot (QLED), MiniLED, and MicroLED. It integrates AI voice assistants, AIoT smart home connectivity, and Dolby audio-visual technologies. Air conditioners employ R32 eco-friendly refrigerants, variable frequency technology, and smart cloud control systems. The company emphasizes energy efficiency, environmental protection, and smart IoT integration in product development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves domestic customers in Taiwan, including large retail chains, 3C chain stores, e-commerce platforms, telecom operators, convenience stores, supermarkets, and traditional appliance dealers. Its products target residential and small commercial users, with a focus on smart home consumers and health-conscious buyers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are primarily focused on the Taiwan domestic market. It plans to expand into Southeast Asia (ASEAN) markets by leveraging existing partners with regional experience. The company also aims to globalize its HERAN brand beyond Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on product design, assembly, branding, marketing, and distribution. It sources key components like LCD panels and compressors from international suppliers and integrates them into finished products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing product performance and customer experience through AI-driven image processing, voice recognition, and smart home integration. The company invests in eco-friendly refrigerants and energy-efficient technologies to meet government carbon neutrality goals. It is building an open innovation ecosystem with AIoT, multi-modal sensing, and next-gen communication protocols, while strengthening information security and privacy protection.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of branded household appliances and electronic devices. The company also earns income from licensing and partnerships related to smart TV platforms and IoT services. It maintains diversified sales channels including physical retail, e-commerce, and telecom distribution.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with domestic and international brands from Japan, Korea, Europe, America, and China in the home appliance and display markets. It holds a leading position in Taiwan for air conditioners with about 21% market share and around 5.6% share in LCD displays. It differentiates through local brand recognition, product innovation, and comprehensive after-sales service.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$6.42 billion, a 3.63% increase year-over-year. Net profit declined by 17.7% to NT$467 million due to rising raw material costs and inventory clearance. The company maintains steady growth with ongoing investments in R&D and market expansion, supported by a workforce of nearly 1,000 employees.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, energy-efficient, and environmentally friendly products with advanced smart features. Its HERAN brand offers differentiated products with AI voice control, IoT connectivity, and superior audio-visual experiences. It leads in eco-friendly refrigerant adoption and smart home integration, providing customers with health-conscious, convenient, and innovative home appliance solutions.
